current.text: Bryant is back in Cleveland as the backup center behind Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley. He is the only backup big. Ernest Udeh Jr. and Khalifa Diop are behind him.
The expert projects him as the 10th man in the rotation. He expects him to play most nights because Cleveland's center depth is so poor.
Cleveland lost Dean Wade, which removes its small-ball center option. The team may still close games with Mobley at center.
He is only a stash in roto, weekly, deep bench and games-cap leagues. If both Allen and Mobley were out, he could be a top 50 to 60 player.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league. With a March 28 end, they play 4, 3 and 2 games in the fantasy playoff weeks, so the finals week has only two games.
One expert projects Cleveland for about 51 to 53 wins.

durable.text: Experts call him a bad real-life player: inconsistent, with bad shooting and weak defense at times. Even so, he puts up fantasy value when he plays.
Steals are a clear weakness. He gets about 0.4 per game in his small role.
